tools.name: list_peopleanalyst_feeds
tools.description: List PeopleAnalyst's free machine-readable feeds and their MCP/REST availability. OpenAPI is also published at https://peopleanalyst.com/openapi.json.

tools.name: get_membership_offer
tools.description: Returns the people analytics chapter of the Bicycle Cooperative membership offer: five options (enterprise member, practitioner member, worker, practitioner rent, enterprise rent) with chapter substitution applied and this front's join URL.

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Returns one authored /answers page as structured content: question, markdown answer body (short answer, problem frame, evidence, grounded sources), and citations with libraryId or url. Known slugs (33): measure-employee-performance, survey-validity-check, people-analytics-program-maturity, people-an

tools.name: get_product_description
tools.description: Machine-readable description of each PeopleAnalyst product. Versioned, CORS-open descriptions of every product in the portfolio — name, category, oneLiner, problemFrames, capabilities, beachheads, whenNotToUse (honest disqualifiers), canonicalUrls, relatedProducts. Assembled from canon. Pass ?produc

tools.name: get_marketing_registry
tools.description: The Pitboss marketing-asset registry (typed cards + personas). Cross-site marketing-asset cards built from the portfolio's brandscripts and proofs, plus the persona set. ?product filters to one product; ?status filters by lifecycle.

tools.name: get_brandscripts
tools.description: Per-persona StoryBrand arguments for each product. The persona-level argument layer (SB7-shaped): the major problem solved for a persona and what the solution looks like. ?product / ?persona filter; ?status opts into drafts.

tools.name: get_story_tracks

tools.description: Falsifiable scene templates — one claim plus what would make it false. The cards a story is told with. tools.name: plan_next_data_ask
tools.description: What data to ask for next, and what it would rule out. The acquisition planner. Given which data-stories are still candidates, returns the single most efficient next question, the full ranked list, and the minimum set of asks that makes every live story testable — split into what can be sent today v

tools.name: get_insight_cards
tools.description: A pitch rendered as player-ready InsightCards. Serves a named pitch as an ordered InsightCard[] (the cross-site insight-player contract). ?pitch selects the pitch; ?awareness optionally reshapes the sequence for the buyer's awareness state.

tools.name: get_situations
tools.description: Demonstration scenarios (discovered → diagnosed → solved). The proof layer paired with brandscripts: concrete situations a product resolves. ?product filters; ?status opts into drafts.

tools.name: list_answers
tools.description: List every query-shaped answer. Returns every authored /answers page as a lightweight list: slug, title, question, canonicalUrl, updatedAt. Use get_answer(slug) for the full markdown body and citations.
